claims: Artemis 2 is not a SpaceX rocket.
Artemis 2 uses NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
SpaceX is involved in later Artemis missions for lunar landers.
An article from Reuters notes that Artemis 2 is an independent, government-run mission.
The Space Launch System (SLS) is built by Boeing and Northrop Grumman.
The Space Launch System (SLS) launches Artemis 2.
The Orion spacecraft is built by Lockheed Martin.
The Orion spacecraft carries the crew for Artemis 2.
Artemis 2 is a 10-day crewed flyby around the Moon.
SpaceX is contracted to build the human landing system (Starship HLS) for Artemis III and IV.
SpaceX is not launching the Artemis II crew.
An article from Florida Today clarifies that Artemis II is a NASA project.
An article from Florida Today clarifies that a separate SpaceX Falcon 9 mission is scheduled immediately following Artemis II
